title: Create custom visual effects with SwiftUI
description: Discover how to create stunning visual effects in SwiftUI. Learn to build unique scroll effects, rich color treatments, and custom transitions. We’ll also explore advanced graphic effects using Metal shaders and custom text rendering.

codeSnippets.title: Scroll view with pagination
Rotation effect
codeSnippets.code:
AnimalPhoto(image: animal)
    .scrollTransition(
        axis: .horizontal
    ) { content, phase in
        content
            .rotationEffect(.degrees(phase.value * 2.5))
            .offset(y: phase.isIdentity ? 0 : 8)
    }

codeSnippets.title: Parallax Effect
Visual effect hue rotation
codeSnippets.code:
RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 24)
    .fill(.purple)
    .visualEffect({ content, proxy in
        content
            .hueRotation(Angle(degrees: proxy.frame(in: .global).origin.y / 10))

    })
